recommendation: Keep the audit commit. If the work group wants the current schema regex to enforce the narrative SHALL for full dateTime offsets, raise a new current-version tracker or reconsider the FHIR-52878-related decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-14094 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 correction asking that fhir-base.xsd use the same dateTime regex as the datatype page and enforce a time zone when hours and minutes are specified.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly names FHIR-14094, but the Jira comment says it had already happened under another task. Oct. 30, 2017 commits f2b3f28b2ff336fda895e176b2bdb2690ade688b and ffb483245175ff499a837bc605277a047ffa7b12 applied related primitive dateTime regex and validation work for FHIR-13684, FHIR-13685, FHIR-12959, and FHIR-12960.
additional_context: The current checkout does not have a checked-in fhir-base.xsd source file; the active primitive source is source/datatypes/primitives.xml, rendered through source/datatypes.html and routed by source/fhir.ini. Later decisions FHIR-34355, FHIR-38735, and FHIR-52878 changed the dateTime regex family. The FHIR-52878 Zulip discussion says regexes need not enforce every rule, and FHIR-I approved the current R6 regex shape.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Tightening the current dateTime regex to make the offset mandatory would undo later approved behavior rather than reconcile the current specification under the STU3 issue.
